---
// Copy to site/src/pages/<name>.astro. Replace the capitalised placeholders.
// Full-bleed page with the dark plate, gold edge and paper body.
import Base from '../layouts/Base.astro';
import { plateEdge, EDGE_DEPTH } from '../lib/bowl';

const edge = plateEdge('PAGE-SLUG');
const clip = `polygon(0 0,100% 0,${[...edge].reverse().map(([x, d]) => `${x.toFixed(1)}% calc(100% - ${d.toFixed(1)}px)`).join(',')})`;
const line = edge.map(([x, d]) => `${(x * 10).toFixed(0)},${(EDGE_DEPTH - d).toFixed(1)}`).join(' ');
---

<Base title="PAGE TITLE — wAIbi-sabi" description="MAX 160 CHARACTERS" section="SECTION" immersive>
  <section class="pg-plate" style={`clip-path:${clip}`}>
    <div class="wrap pg-plate__in">
      <h1>ONE HEADING PER PAGE</h1>
      <p>ONE SENTENCE ON WHAT THIS PAGE IS FOR.</p>
    </div>
  </section>
  <svg class="pg-edge" viewBox={`0 0 1000 ${EDGE_DEPTH}`} preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true">
    <polyline points={line} vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" />
  </svg>

  <div class="wrap pg-body">
    <!-- Content. Reuse patterns listed in docs/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md. -->
  </div>
</Base>
